key_insight: EERLoss directly optimizes a subdifferentiable approximation of Equal Error Rate, aligning training with the biometric verification metric that matters most.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a task-aligned objective that can improve deep biometric model training, speed convergence, and potentially optimize other DET operating points.
method: Approximate EER with a subdifferentiable, arbitrarily accurate loss function.
Train deep biometric models using this direct verification objective instead of indirect classification losses.
Validate on keystroke dynamics and compare against state-of-the-art losses and a winning benchmark architecture retrained with EERLoss.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on the KVC-onGoing benchmark with over 185,000 subjects across scenarios, where retraining achieved up to about a 30% relative EER reduction and faster convergence.
watch_item: Because it is an approximation to a non-smooth metric, performance may depend on how accurately the EER surrogate is tuned and whether the target operating point matches deployment needs.
paper_title: EERLoss: A Novel Loss Function for Training Deep Biometric Models. A Case Study in Keystroke Dynamics
